claims.value: 143 Thermo .raw files, each linked to 10 TMT channels
claims.evidence: files_all.json lists 143 RAW names matching ^\d{8}_Philippine_LC_TMTB0[345]_prot_F\d+-R[12]\.raw$; TMTB03 missing F01-R1 (47 files); TMTB04 and TMTB05 have 48 files each.

claims.value: TMT126, TMT127N, TMT127C, TMT128N, TMT128C, TMT129N, TMT129C, TMT130N, TMT130C, TMT131N
claims.evidence: Table S2 is TMT10 channels 126-131 with N/C splits; PD template TMT10; PRIDE quantificationMethods TMT. Channel 131 written as TMT131N (TMT10plex).

claims.location: source name / factor value[disease] patient rows
claims.value: 12 patients, paired NAT (normal) and Tumor (lung adenocarcinoma); TMTB03=S12,S13,S18,S19; TMTB04=S01,S03,S04,S24; TMTB05=S10,S11,S20,S22
claims.evidence: Table S2 TMT labeling assignments with NAT/Tumor per channel and three batches. Table S6 headers F1/F2=S12 (Batch 1), F3/F4=S01 (Batch 2), F5/F6=S10 (Batch 3) match TMTB03/04/05 chronological order. PRIDE protocol: paired tumor and NAT from Filipino early-stage NSCLC LUAD. Abstract: paired tumor and adjacent normal LUAD.

claims.value: pooled reference channels TMT126=Control NT, TMT131N=Control T
claims.evidence: Table S2 caption: Control NT = pooled tumor tissues and NATs; Control T = pooled tumor tissues. PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol: scaling to designated reference channels (Control NT). Exact patient membership of each pool is not listed; characteristics[pooled sample] and characteristics[biological replicate] are the reserved word pooled.
PRIDE organisms NCBITaxon:9606; human LUAD cohort.
Surgical lung tumor and NAT tissue; OLS UBERON:0002048 lung.

Inclusion: histopathologically proven NSCLC adenocarcinoma. Abstract and PRIDE protocol specify LUAD. NAT is adjacent normal lung; not assigned the project-level NSCLC term. OLS MONDO:0005061 lung adenocarcinoma; PATO:0000461 normal.

claims.value: per-patient male/female and Smoker/Never Smoker from Table S6 headers
claims.evidence: Table S6 abundance column headers encode Sample, Normal|Tumor, SxxN|SxxT, Male|Female, Smoker|Nonsmoker. Nonsmoker mapped to NCIT Never Smoker; Smoker to NCIT Smoker.
No per-sample ages in Table S1/S2/S6 or PRIDE. Inclusion allows 18-90 years; that is not a per-sample age.
Table S1 inclusion: patient must be Filipino and 18-90 years of age. PRIDE protocol: Filipino patients. OLS HANCESTRO:0498 Filipino; EFO:0001272 adult.
PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: phosphopeptide enrichment using IMAC StageTips (Fe3+-NTA). OLS PRIDE:0000587 IMAC.
PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol and instruments field: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos. techsdrf not installed; raw headers not range-read.
PRIDE protocol: Top10 DDA workflow, HCD MS2. PD template name contains MS2 SequestHT, not DIA.
PRIDE protocol: HCD MS2 scans at 60,000 resolution. ReporterIonQuantifierNode ActivationTypeFilter DisplayValue=HCD. Workflow description also says CID spectra using SequestHT (template boilerplate).
PD Sequest node Enzyme Name DisplayValue=Trypsin (Full). Wet-lab protocol also used Lys-C then trypsin; search enzyme is trypsin only.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; TMT6plex K and Any N-term fixed; Oxidation M variable; Deamidated N,Q variable; Phospho STY variable; Acetyl Protein N-term variable
claims.evidence: Sequest node in workflow.xml: Static Carbamidomethyl C, Static TMT6plex K, StaticTerminal TMT6plex Any N-Terminus, Dynamic Oxidation M, Deamidated N/Q, Phospho STY, DynamicModificationNProtein Acetyl. PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol lists the same set. search-params mapped Acetyl as Any N-term; SDRF uses Protein N-term from DynamicModificationNProtein. MappingL / J skipped (not a biological PTM).

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance] / comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: Sequest node PeptideTolerance 10 ppm and FragmentTolerance 0.1 Da. PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol: 10 ppm precursor, 0.1 Da fragment. An earlier workflow node lists 20 ppm; Sequest/PRIDE 10 ppm used.
PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: reduced with 10 mM DTT; alkylated with 5 mM iodoacetamide. Search includes fixed Carbamidomethyl.

claims.value: High-pH reversed-phase chromatography (hpHRP); comment[fraction identifier] equals the Fxx integer in comment[data file]
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol: high-pH RP into 96 fractions concatenated into 12 pooled fractions. Deposited files are F01-F24 x R1/R2; file names outrank the '12 fractions' sentence. R1 vs R2 are technical replicate injections of the same Fxx fraction. TMTB03 F01-R1.raw is undeposited, so TMTB03 R1 has fraction identifiers 2-24 (gap at 1) rather than compacted 1-23.
Raw-file infix TMTB03/04/05; Table S2 three batches.
Table S2 caption: Control NT = pooled tumor tissues and NATs; Control T = pooled tumor tissues. sample-metadata / TERMS.tsv allow pooled on biological replicate for TMT reference channels.

claims.value: ms-proteomics v1.1.0, human v1.1.0, oncology-metadata v1.0.0
claims.evidence: MS proteomics of human LUAD tissue (cancer study). Not DIA, not cell lines, not single-cell. oncology-metadata supplies the clinical columns used (age, sex, ancestry, smoking).

limitations: Full paper HTML/PDF is closed (ACS Cloudflare 403; Unpaywall closed; no PMCID). Methods used are PRIDE sample/data processing protocols plus ACS SI on Figshare.
No per-sample age, tumor stage, or histologic subtype table beyond LUAD inclusion.
Exact SN= membership of Control NT / Control T pools is not in Table S2; pooled is written without SN= lists because the validator rejected SN= values.
TMTB03 F01-R1.raw is absent from the deposit; comment[fraction identifier] on remaining TMTB03 R1 files uses the filename F number (2-24) so R1 and R2 of the same Fxx share an identifier.
techsdrf is not installed; instrument model was not confirmed from a .raw header.
Wet-lab Lys-C pre-digest is not represented in comment[cleavage agent details] because the PD search enzyme is Trypsin (Full) only.
sdrf-tools reconcile reported cleavage_agent_unsupported for Trypsin against the PRIDE record; the sampleProcessingProtocol text does name trypsin after Lys-C.
